title: P15.9-A2 production default Company Cockpit cutover with explicit legacy rollback
description: BASE bdeae5aa651cbfb586ed23a1dd09ff448dda0730. Owner-approved P15.9-A2 UI cutover: Vite production builds default legacy routes to modern /app, root to /app/company, while Vite dev remains legacy-first for existing integration regression coverage. Existing pair.legacy_redirect='app' still forces new UI; 'legacy' enables immediate per-browser rollback even in production. All known route mappings, preserved mission id/query/hash, and /ui bypass remain. Added explicit rollback regression and operator runbook. Zero API, DB, objective, cost, scheduler, auth, auto-driver or executor changes. Production-built-dist browser smoke plus npm run verify:change, typecheck/build and independent audit are deployment prerequisites and HAVE NOT been executed by ChatGPT in this sandbox; no live deployment or PR merge is claimed.
